partners.mechanism_chain: ELOVL1 (HGNC:3230) —DISRUPTS→ Fatty acid elongation (GO:0006634); ELOVL4 (HGNC:3231) —DISRUPTS→ Fatty acid elongation (GO:0006634); Fatty acid elongation (GO:0006634) —LEADS_TO→ Sphingolipid metabolism (GO:0006660); Sphingolipid metabolism (GO:0006660) —LEADS_TO→ Spinocerebellar ataxia (HP:0001273); Sphingolipid metabolism (GO:0006660) —LEADS_TO→ Ichthyosis (HP:0000970); Sphingolipid metabolism (GO:0006660) —LEADS_TO→ Spasticity (HP:0001257); Sphingolipid metabolism (GO:0006660) —LEADS_TO→ Hypomyelination (HP:0033161); Sphingolipid metabolism (GO:0006660) —LEADS_TO→ Dysmorphic facial features (HP:0001999). Mutations in ELOVL1 and ELOVL4 disrupt the fatty acid elongation pathway, which is critical for the synthesis of very long-chain fatty acids (VLCFAs).
